commons.title: PB177541 Detail Mwana Hiti Figure with beaded headdress on a decorated calabash, Zigua, Tanzania (10896960324).jpg
commons.description:
This unusual little figure is adorned with a beaded cap and stands on a gourd studded with hard shelled red & black seeds and cowrie shells. There are remnants of a feather band around the centre of the gourd.
This piece may have been used as an ancestor figure.
It measures 42cm and the gourd is 15cm wide.
Price is AUD550
